question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word

Expand
solution:
The correct answer is: **Shrink.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Expand"** means to increase in size, number, or importance. (विस्तार करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company plans to expand its operations into new markets.
 
 
 
• **"Shrink"** means to become smaller in size, amount, or value. (सिकुड़ना)
 
 
• **Example: **Woolen clothes tend to shrink when washed in hot water.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"Expand"** is **"Shrink"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Inflate** (फुलाना): To fill with air or gas.

 
 
• **Example:** The balloon will inflate when you blow air into it.
 
 
 
• **Protect** (सुरक्षित करना): To keep safe from harm or injury.
 
 
• **Example:** We must protect our environment for future generations.
 
 
 
• **Network** (नेटवर्क): A group or system of interconnected people or things.
 
 
• **Example:** She has a vast network of contacts in the industry.
